summary: Regression pass after requirements.txt restoration. Backend starts cleanly (no ImportError in supervisor logs), GET /api/ returns Hello World. All 9 auth pytest cases pass (session, /me bearer+cookie, expired, bogus, logout). Frontend hero renders and scrolling to laptop reveals login screen with data-testid=google-signin-button (visible, text 'Sign in with Google'). Only console errors are expected 401s from guest /api/auth/me. httpx integration verified working via successful session/logout flows.
critical_code_review_comments: requirements.txt is now a clean curated list (29 packages including httpx>=0.28.1) - no leaked internal packages. Good.
Non-blocking: guest visit produces 2x 401 console errors from /api/auth/me before AuthContext resolves - could be silenced by checking cookie first client-side, but harmless.
test_credentials: MongoDB seeded (idempotent via setup_module): user_id=test-user-auth1, session_token=test_session_auth1
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: python -m pytest backend/tests/test_auth.py -v. Frontend laptop login: scroll window.innerHeight*2.6, wait 3s (Lenis), then query data-testid=google-signin-button.
